findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext discards logs
findings.body: TestLogger.FromContext returns a brand new NewTestLogger() instead of the receiver. LoggerMiddleware now logs via m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...), so when the injected logger is a TestLogger the Info call is recorded on a throwaway instance that is immediately discarded. Any test asserting on InfoLogs/WarnLogs on the original fake will see zero calls and cannot verify logging behavior.

findings.title: LoggerMiddleware loses traceID and depends on outer middleware
findings.body: logRequest no longer adds pluginId, endpoint, uname, dsName/dsUID and traceID explicitly and instead relies on m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info. The contextual attributes (endpoint, pluginId, dsName, etc.) are only added by ContextualLoggerMiddleware, and traceID is added nowhere: instrumentContext in contextual_logger_middleware.go does not add traceID, and the old tracing.TraceIDFromContext logic was deleted. If LoggerMiddleware is used standalone, in tests, or in a different order, logs lose those fields, and in the current stack trace correlation via traceID is regressed even when ordering is correct.

findings.title: Shared MetricsMiddleware instance mutates next
findings.body: NewMetricsMiddleware creates one imw via newMetricsMiddleware and the returned ClientMiddlewareFunc does imw.next = next; return imw on every application. The same *MetricsMiddleware value is therefore shared and mutated. If the middleware decorates more than one client or is constructed concurrently, the last next wins and concurrent QueryData/CallResource calls race on the next field. NewContextualLoggerMiddleware in the same PR correctly creates a fresh struct per application; MetricsMiddleware should do the same.

findings.title: Metrics middleware panics on nil request
findings.body: QueryData, CallResource, CheckHealth and CollectMetrics unconditionally dereference req (e.g. req.Queries, req.PluginContext, req.Body) without a nil guard. LoggerMiddleware in the same package explicitly short-circuits when req == nil. A nil request through MetricsMiddleware therefore panics with a nil-pointer dereference instead of delegating to the next client.
